Research Methods & Skills — Evidence, Reflection & Communication — source 3
slides.text:
Aims
To develop your research, graduate attributes, problem-solving and decision-making skills supported through different forms of data assimilation/synthesis, communication, critical evaluation, and statistical analysis of data.
To develop individual and group creativity to address problems that require a collaborative and multi-disciplinary approach. 
To increase awareness and understanding of employment opportunities and the skills and attributes required by employers.

Learning outcomes: 
Demonstrate ability to plan personal development through reflection on a skills diagnostic. 
Demonstrate use of the graduate attributes to explore problems within the context of your discipline. 

Level 4 Navigate
Learning outcomes: 
Demonstrate the ability to critically evaluate own personal development through reflection on progress and goals. 
Demonstrate use of the Kingston University attributes to explore problems beyond your discipline.

Explore experience

Learning outcomes
Demonstrate ability to take responsibility for your own learning and development, using reflection and critical analysis to plan and implement actions. 
Articulate, to an identified audience, the development of key Kingston University graduate attributes appropriate for your future success beyond the University.
